Active code-style/toolchain docs were also added to the Buck2 authority scanner so Cargo-style verification prescriptions cannot re-enter those standards without failing the policy target.

best_practice_research.question: Rust language optimization for release / production under Oyatie Buck2 authority constraints
best_practice_research.direct_recommendation: Use measured release-artifact optimization experiments only after Buck2 gates are proven. Treat Cargo release/custom profiles, rustc codegen flags, PGO, and allocator selection as evidence-gathering for production release binaries/images, then encode any selected behavior into Buck2 toolchain/target/OCI paths. Do not use Cargo as CI/CD/build/test authority.
